findings.title: Decision-seam traceability is not explicit
findings.detail: v0.1 states that open seams are preserved, but it does not provide a 60/60 architecture seam matrix tied to the frozen Decision IDs. A freeze review cannot prove that no seam was accidentally resolved.

findings.title: External-provider transaction choreography is ambiguous
findings.detail: The architecture says provider calls occur outside the DB transaction, but does not define pre-call/post-call choreography for card/QR/refund uncertainty, durable attempt/commitment state, crash points, and reconciliation. This is critical to the frozen PaymentAttempt/PaymentCommitment/PostedTender model.

findings.title: Shared UnitOfWork boundary lacks a concrete module-safe persistence contract
findings.detail: v0.1 says coordinators share one transaction, but does not specify how module-private repositories receive a transaction-scoped session without exposing schemas or allowing accidental independent commits.

findings.title: Store Node API trust/session model is incomplete
findings.detail: TLS/device enrollment are named, but the architecture does not define counter identity, user session propagation, authorization context resolution, replay/idempotency binding, or how LAN clients are prevented from impersonating another counter.

findings.title: Sync ownership/apply contract is under-specified
findings.detail: Outbox/inbox flow is described, but there is no explicit message ownership matrix, apply-handler contract, schema/version compatibility behavior, or rule preventing cloud-owned/configuration updates from mutating store-owned transactional facts.

findings.title: Upgrade compatibility gate is not operationally complete
findings.detail: Client/Store Node/schema compatibility ranges are mentioned, but startup/rolling-upgrade choreography, write gating, expand-contract sequencing, and rollback behavior across POS, Store Node, DB and sync protocol are not specified.

findings.title: Read/query architecture is under-defined
findings.detail: Transactional module ownership is clear, but cross-module search/reporting/read-model construction, freshness, rebuildability, and whether Store Node queries may join schemas are not sufficiently specified.

findings.title: BusinessContext resolution order and authority are incomplete
findings.detail: BusinessContext fields are listed, but exact resolution authority for Tenant/Company/Store/Counter/User, BusinessDate and CountryRuleSetVersion—and failure behavior when context cannot be resolved—is not fully specified.

findings.title: Background worker concurrency/leadership is unspecified
findings.detail: Outbox, reconciliation and scheduled jobs exist, but multi-process/duplicate-worker safety, leasing/locking, retry backoff and shutdown semantics are not architecturally fixed.

findings.title: Database connection and transaction policy is incomplete
findings.detail: No pool sizing principle, transaction timeout/statement timeout, lock timeout, cancellation, retry classification or connection-loss handling is defined for Posting Envelopes.

findings.title: Observability lacks audit/telemetry separation and cardinality controls
findings.detail: Structured telemetry is listed, but security/audit evidence versus operational logs, PII redaction, metric cardinality, retention and correlation across desktop/Store Node/cloud are not sufficiently bounded.

findings.title: Hardware command lifecycle is incomplete
findings.detail: Ports are defined, but device timeout/cancellation, printer duplicate-risk, cash-drawer behavior, scanner/scale reconnect, capability/version negotiation and hardware error taxonomy are missing.

findings.title: Configuration ownership and precedence are not specified
findings.detail: The runtime loads configuration, but local machine, store, company, country-pack and cloud-delivered configuration precedence/versioning and safe activation are not defined.

findings.title: Support/diagnostics architecture needs stronger isolation
findings.detail: Support sessions are time-limited/audited, but remote diagnostic access, command allow-listing, elevation, secret/database access restrictions and offline behavior are not concretely separated.

findings.title: Cloud-mode composition needs an explicit capability matrix
findings.detail: The same modular-monolith codebase is reused, but the exact Store-only, Cloud-only and shared capabilities/workers are not enumerated, leaving risk that cloud accidentally gains store posting authority.

findings.title: Reconciliation/rebuild ownership is not fully specified
findings.detail: Drift detection is mentioned, but the architecture does not define which module owns each reconciliation, whether repair is rebuild-only or compensating, and how repair is authorized/audited.

findings.title: API transport protocol naming is premature/inconsistent
findings.detail: The topology says HTTPS/LAN while deployment details do not define certificate/discovery mechanics. Keep transport security mandatory but defer concrete discovery/certificate profile to API/deployment contract.

findings.title: Monorepo package graph needs machine-enforceable boundary metadata
findings.detail: CI rules are described, but no concrete dependency tags/lint boundary scheme is specified.

findings.title: Terminology for Customer & Credit package should be normalized
findings.detail: Documentation alternates between Customer & Credit and customer-credit; this is understandable but should be normalized in the freeze candidate.
